Here's a reliable, fudgy brownie recipe that's safe to make if you follow the instructions and bake it fully.

Easy Fudgy Brownies

Ingredients

115 g unsalted butter

200 g caster sugar

2 large eggs

1 tsp vanilla extract

40 g unsweetened cocoa powder

65 g plain flour

¼ tsp salt

100 g milk or dark chocolate chips (optional)


Instructions

1. Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan).


2. Grease or line a 20 cm × 20 cm baking tin with baking paper.


3. Melt the butter and let it cool for a minute.


4. Whisk the butter and sugar together, then beat in the eggs one at a time.


5. Stir in the vanilla.


6. Sift in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt, then fold together until just combined.


7. Fold in the chocolate chips if using.


8. Pour the batter into the tin and smooth the top.


9. Bake for 20–25 minutes. A toothpick inserted into the centre should come out with a few moist crumbs (not wet batter).


10. Let the brownies cool in the tin for at least 20–30 minutes before cutting.



Tips

Don't eat the batter because it contains raw eggs and uncooked flour.

Let the brownies cool before slicing—they'll become fudgier as they set.

Store in an airtight container for up to 4 days.


Enjoy your brownies! 🍫
